name: @pinpoint/map
comment: The only dependency is @pinpoint/tokens, which itself has none — so this package still declares no RUNTIME dependency outside the workspace, and that is the property the boundary protects. It must stay renderer-agnostic so the same logic drives maplibre-gl on web and maplibre-react-native on native. A dependency on either renderer, a DOM API, or a native module is a signal the code belongs in an app instead — see openspec/specs/monorepo-structure.
